One needs a deterministic-start smoothing or overlap estimate, such as:
\[
P_{t_0}(x,\cdot)\not\perp P_{t_0}(y,\cdot)\quad\forall x,y,
\]
or the compact-local Hellinger estimate of Proposition 7, or
compact-local uniform \(\nu\)-absolute continuity as in Proposition
8, or pointwise resolvent absolute continuity as in Proposition
10.  These are not consequences of weak convergence alone.
